data.body: **[P1] Abort delayed checkpoints as soon as a plugin fatal is published.** `submit` checks only `terminalFailure`, which is not set until a flush eventually observes `pluginFatal`. With a nonzero checkpoint delay, an at-most-once worker can remain blocked on its START while `ExecutionManager.close()` waits for that worker before flushing, hanging until timeout. Make fatal publication actively abort pending batcher futures and reject later submissions; test an externally signaled fatal with a long delayed START.
